title: Business Office Calculation: Seat Waiver Amount on a Waiting-List Courtesy Permit Fee (Student Transportation Services)
content:
**Definition.** The Student Transportation Services seat waiver is the seat's permit fee as posted, times the status share, times the covered months, divided by one hundred and by the seat months, never more than the fee net of every credit already against it, rounded half-up to the cent once on the result.

- **Status share.** The reduced-price meal waiver share of the fee table, 50 percent.
- **Seat months.** The whole calendar months from the month the fee posted through the last month of the permit period, that month included. The last month is December (the permit period ending December 31, 2026) for a fall semester fee and May (ending May 31, 2027) otherwise.
- **Covered months.** All the seat months.
- **Fee net of every credit already against it.** The permit fee less every credit entry posted against that fee.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A school-year seat fee of 150.00 USD posted on November 10, with no credit against it yet:

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| seat months, November through May | 7 |
| covered months | 7 |
| 150.00 times 50, times 7, divided by 100 and by 7 | 75.00 |
| cap: fee net of credits | 150.00, not reached |
| rounded half-up to the cent | 75.00 USD |

A fall semester seat fee of 90.00 USD posted on October 20 has seat months October through December, 3, and a seat waiver of 45.00 USD.

## Point of judgement

- **A fee already carrying a credit (hypothetical).** A seat fee of 150.00 already carrying credits of 100.00 is capped at its net, 50.00, so the seat waiver figured at 75.00 is 50.00.
